method: Maintainer-assistant reading review from public Home/Operate navigation and linked production pages; no ADR required
scope: Discoverability and explanation review, not an independent operator usability trial or live production deployment
friction_fixed: Doctor exit policies mixed with unrelated check descriptions
No primary Doctor entry for strict production and durable preflights
Production guide named a matrix template without linking its format or explaining planned statuses

answers.question: migration_role
answers.heading: 2. Separate migrations from application credentials
answers.answer: Apply versioned migrations in a separate job under the schema owner; grant application/internal table privileges before starting new processes.

answers.question: application_role
answers.heading: 2. Separate migrations from application credentials
answers.answer: Use a restricted NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS login with only needed schema, DML and sequence privileges.

answers.question: rls
answers.heading: 3. Establish tenant isolation
answers.answer: Resolve tenant membership on the server; enable and force RLS; test denial under the real restricted role. Flags declare posture and do not create policies.

answers.question: services
answers.heading: Deploy an Aksara application
answers.answer: Provide PostgreSQL, TLS, secrets, supervision, monitoring and backups; no Redis or separate workflow service is required for durability.

answers.question: task_worker
answers.heading: 5. Start background execution explicitly
answers.answer: Ordinary workers start in each database-backed application lifespan by default; disable the embedded worker explicitly if using dedicated processes.

answers.question: durable_worker
answers.heading: 5. Start background execution explicitly
answers.answer: Supervise an explicit worker entry point with matching actions/resolvers and tenant; the framework does not enumerate a tenant fleet.

answers.question: doctor
answers.heading: Production release policy
answers.answer: Run production-check --release with the deployed environment and reviewed matrix; preserve exit status. Planned template scenarios cannot pass unchanged.

answers.question: durability_check
answers.heading: Durable-operation preflight
answers.answer: Call check_durable_operations on a connected, registered service per namespace/tenant after migrations. This is separate from Doctor security policy.

answers.question: retention
answers.heading: 6. Operate retention and external effects
answers.answer: Own bounded export and pruning schedules; match retention and idempotency promises and reconcile unknown external outcomes.

answers.question: backups_and_monitoring
answers.heading: 6. Operate retention and external effects
answers.answer: Back up and restore-test PostgreSQL, media and exports; monitor leases, retries, authorization denials, outbox, pools and external uncertainty.

answers.question: upgrade
answers.heading: 7. Upgrade deliberately
answers.answer: Test a restored database, apply migrations first and retain referenced action/resolver versions; a wheel downgrade is not an effect/schema reversal.

complete_page_reading.reason: Seven ordered deployment steps distinguish framework guarantees from operator duties; roles precede RLS and workers, and links lead to executed tenant examples and explicit preflight recipes.
Rehearsal precedes migration and restricted-role checks; legacy model-only migration fallback is explicit, durability is optional, and rollback is distinguished from schema or effect reversal.
Question-led command table separates local and release exit policies; security coverage declarations and durable preflight limits are explicit; optional Studio is kept outside the production path.

usability_assessment.walls_of_text: Short sections and numbered deployment/upgrade steps keep actions and their prerequisites together.
usability_assessment.jargon: Role privileges, RLS and durable terms link to their dedicated guides; no ADR is needed for the operating sequence.
usability_assessment.nesting: Single main sequence per deployment/upgrade page; Doctor uses a shallow command-selection table.
usability_assessment.duplication: Repeated role/worker cautions are short context reminders and cross-link the detailed guides.
usability_assessment.navigation: Deployment links to upgrade, tenancy, background tasks, durable preflight and stability; Doctor links back to deployment.
usability_assessment.task_orientation: Configure, migrate, restrict, check, serve, supervise and recover appear in execution order.
usability_assessment.cross_links: The linked recipes cover the concrete tenant and worker setup omitted from the overview.
usability_assessment.tutorial_reference_separation: Deployment and upgrade describe operator actions; setting defaults and full API recipes live in linked references.
